svg.title: Toolkit. Languages: Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, SQL. Frontend: React, Next.js, React Native, Tailwind CSS. Backend: Node.js, Express, Django, REST, GraphQL. Cloud & devops: Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud, AWS, CI/CD, Nginx, Linux. Data & ai: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, LangChain, LLM integration.
